brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION
Use case: illustration-story.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese editorial basketball thumbnail, wide 16:9, preferably 1600x900 or larger, opaque PNG. This is a brand-new illustration, not a photograph.
Visual style: match the previously viewed approved B-culver-black-lime-v3 style: deep charcoal #151A18 background, electric lime #CCF43B broad dry-brush strokes, ivory chunky Japanese typography, energetic pen-and-ink crosshatching, sparse purposeful composition. Do not transfer any player, text, date or score from the style sample.
Subject: ONE real basketball player, Tomoya Ochiai / 落合知也, selected randomly from the fixed article's listed players. No fictional people, no opponent. Use the official portrait just viewed (B.LEAGUE 2026-27 roster, PlayerID 8648) solely as visual likeness reference, never paste or reproduce the photograph. Distinctive features: Japanese man with light tan skin, short dark undercut sides and longer blond-dyed top swept over to one side with visible dark roots; high forehead, elongated oval face, slightly angular defined jaw, expressive almond-shaped eyes, gently arched eyebrows, straight nose, clean-shaven mouth and chin, long neck and strong athletic shoulders. Keep face clearly legible in warm ivory and gray ink, not blacked out. Keep a mature athletic face resembling the portrait, not generic anime.
Pose and framing: place him on LEFT 43% of canvas, in a low forward-driving basketball dribble pose, three-quarter view, bent knees, torso angled diagonally forward, one hand on top of a single orange basketball near hip/lower-left foreground, other arm naturally bent for balance. Render correct hands, natural finger count and joint structure. Face, hands and the full basketball inside the image with comfortable margins; lower legs may intentionally finish outside the lower edge. Plain black sleeveless jersey with a thin magenta neckline detail and plain shorts. No jersey numbers, names, sponsorship text, team/league logos or brand marks. Do NOT include other people, hoop, crowd or arena signage. The pose is an imagined basketball illustration, not a reconstruction of this actual game. No victory, score, appearance, performance or decisive-shot claim.
Composition: player on LEFT; clear spacious headline block on RIGHT occupying approximately 52%, clear separation between ink figure and Japanese type. Lime dry-brush diagonal motion accents behind player, dark quiet field behind type. All text fully inside canvas, no clutter or overlaps. High-contrast exceptionally legible Japanese letters; heavy editorial Gothic type. The huge focal headline has two lines, the first in ivory and second in lime.
Use ONLY the following exact visible text, and render every line accurately:
Top small: 「バスケまとめ」
Upper right date/category: 「2026.11.05｜B.NEXT」
Medium right matchup: 「品川 vs 三重」
Main headline line 1: 「公式記録」
Main headline line 2: 「確定待ち」
Below headline, small but legible: 「11/05 19:53 JST時点」
Footer with generous margin: 「イラスト（AI生成）」 and 「イメージ」
Do not print Japanese quotation marks. Do not add any other text. In particular no player name, statistics, score, best-five label, win/loss wording or '成績をもとにしたイメージ'.
Editorial grounding: the only article evidence is the supplied fixed source.html/source.txt: 2026-11-05 Shinagawa versus Mie, B.NEXT, official records pending as of 19:53 JST. Preserve that qualification prominently, not as a tiny disclaimer. Never imply that the randomly chosen player played or achieved anything in this game.
Finish as polished print-like sports ink illustration with a clean thumbnail hierarchy, not photorealistic, not 3D, not official photography.

ONE PERMITTED REVISION
Edit this existing basketball thumbnail. Make ONE targeted layout correction only: the bottom of the orange basketball is cut off, and the player's leftmost elbow meets the edge. Keep the entire basketball and every visible hand fully inside the canvas, with at least 35px dark margin from the left/bottom edges at this resolution. Scale down the entire illustrated player plus basketball together by approximately 12%, maintaining anatomical proportions and his position on the left. Keep his full hair comfortably below the top edge. The lower legs can remain intentionally cropped, but the ball must be a fully visible closed circle and both hands uncut. Preserve his likeness as the real player Tomoya Ochiai: side-swept blond top with dark roots and short dark sides, long clean-shaven face, expressive eyes, strong athletic body. Preserve the ink-and-brush style, charcoal background, lime accents, plain unbranded jersey and magenta neckline. Preserve ALL typography exactly as already drawn and its current placement: バスケまとめ; 2026.11.05｜B.NEXT; 品川 vs 三重; 公式記録; 確定待ち; 11/05 19:53 JST時点; イラスト（AI生成）; イメージ. Do not add names, statistics, scores, jersey numbers, extra people, logos, or photo elements. Keep 1672x941 landscape or equivalent 16:9 dimensions. This is an imagined basketball illustration, not a depiction of an actual game moment.
brief.generator: Built-in image_gen (image_gen__imagegen). 1 initial generation + 1 layout correction. No image API, paid CLI or local pixel editing.
